prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1078; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on the road in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me in your own words what happened?

A: I was stopped at a red light in the right lane. The traffic had been moving slowly, and I was waiting for the light to change. Then I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped back and then forward.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I checked my mirror a second before, but I didn't see it coming. It was going fast, I think.

Q: After the collision, did you get out of your vehicle?

A: I got out, but my lower back was really stiff and sore. I had to hold onto the car door for a moment. The other driver came over and asked if I was okay.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed me with a back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Sitting for long periods bothers me, and bending over to pick things up is difficult. I've been going to physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my medical bills get taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
